thread:
maria: Heads up — after the driver 530 rollout to eu-west-1 (A10 pool) we're seeing repeated NCCL timeouts and GPU process hangs. Affected host groups: euw-gpu-a10-*. Seeing ~5% pod eviction rate on batch jobs. :exclamation:

aj: ugh. any kernel changes in that region too?

maria: yes, some nodes got kernel 6.4.0-12 during the same maintenance window. gist of dmesg below:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.568901] nvidia-modeset: probe of 0000:3b:00 failed with error -12
[ 1234.569012] nvidia_uvm: fatal: aborting because of faulty probe
[ 1234.569123] kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 23s!
```

tom: we saw a similar combo in staging last week — kernel 6.4 + driver 530 caused NCCL allreduce to hang. Temporary mitigation was to disable RDMA/P2P: `export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` and `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` in runner env. Not ideal for perf but stops hangs. :eyes:

priya: I'm oncall — I'll coordinate a targeted hotfix. Proposal: pin affected hosts to driver 525 and hold the package, roll back the driver on the A10 pool only, run smoke test (nccl_allreduce on 4 GPUs), then open a gate to block further 530 upgrades in eu-west-1 until we validate the kernel/driver matrix. Plan steps:
1) Tag hosts: `k8s node-label cluster=euw-gpu-a10 hotfix-driver=525`
2) Run playbook: `ansible -i inventory/euw -l "hotfix-driver=525" -m shell -a \"apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525 && apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-525\"`
3) Restart kubelet/containerd on host, drain & uncordon pods one node at a time
4) Run smoke: `./tools/e2e/nccl_smoke --gpus 4`
5) Monitor for 30m then escalate if failures persist.

aj: SGTM. add a kernel-driver compatibility matrix to the gating config. I can whip up a temporary gate rule `driver_version != 530 || region != eu-west-1` so upgrades stop until we sign off.

jason: Recommend we also publish a hotfix meta-package in apt repo that sets a dpkg hold and contains a simple check script. That makes rollout + rollback atomic and easier to audit.

maria: I'll open the postmortem and add a regression test that runs the matrix (A10 + A100, kernel 6.1/6.4, driver 525/530) in CI. We need to catch this before rollout.

deploy-bot: started playbook run `hotfix/driver-525-rollout` — job #12482 — targeting 18 nodes (euw-gpu-a10).

priya: quick command snippets for ops:
```bash
# rollback + hold
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
sudo apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-525
# verify
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
```

maria: Also testing a software workaround for NCCL: set `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` via k8s mutating webhook for affected daemonsets while we roll the driver back. Low perf but keeps jobs alive.

aj: After rollback, let's run the perf delta on a staging subset (A100) to confirm no regressions. If good, we'll update the upgrade runbook: add `preflight: run-nccl-smoke` and `gates: kernel-driver-matrix`.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0723. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-0723

priya: I'll start the rollback tonight at 02:00 UTC, will keep the run in rolling batches (3 nodes at a time). Tagging @maria @aj for validation windows. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — postmortem + MR for gating rules incoming after stabilization.

aj: one more thing — let's add telemetry to track `Xid 79` counts and NCCL timeouts per node in console so we can auto-detect recurrence.

priya: noted. logging alert rule proposal: `sum(nvidia_xid_79_total) by (node) > 1 -> Pager` — will draft after hotfix.

jason: cool. after we stabilize, schedule a coordinated test matrix upgrade in staging with kernel+driver combos before any region rollouts.

maria: agreed. closing loop once rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
